context: Tests whether the agent correctly documents the first-run setup workflow, data directory file layout, 3-layer profile architecture, and supported feed formats as specified in the rss-curation skill. The agent must produce a setup guide and a sample profile YAML that faithfully reflect the skill's specific instructions without having those details spelled out in the task.

checklist.name: Setup subcommand invocation
checklist.description: setup_guide.md includes the command `node rss-feed.mjs setup` with the `--data-dir` flag (exact subcommand name and flag must appear)

checklist.name: Data directory prompt
checklist.description: setup_guide.md indicates that the user must first choose or provide a data directory path before running the setup command

checklist.name: config.yaml feed editing step
checklist.description: setup_guide.md includes a step to edit `config.yaml` to add RSS/Atom feed URLs

checklist.name: profile.yaml interests step
checklist.description: setup_guide.md includes a step to fill in `profile.yaml` with the user's interests

checklist.name: AGENTS.md / repos scan step
checklist.description: setup_guide.md mentions the optional step of scanning AGENTS.md and/or recent repos to auto-populate the inferred profile layer

checklist.name: Correct step ordering
checklist.description: The steps in setup_guide.md appear in the correct order: (1) choose data directory, (2) run setup command, (3) edit config.yaml, (4) fill profile.yaml, (5) optional AGENTS.md/repos scan

checklist.name: Supported feed formats
checklist.description: setup_guide.md mentions all three supported feed formats: RSS 2.0, Atom, and RSS 1.0 (or RDF)

checklist.name: Data directory file layout
checklist.description: setup_guide.md lists the four expected files/directories inside the data directory: config.yaml, profile.yaml, feeds.db, and digests/ (with YYYY-MM-DD.md pattern)

checklist.name: Explicit profile section
checklist.description: sample_profile.yaml contains a clearly labeled 'explicit' section with example interest entries

checklist.name: Inferred profile section
checklist.description: sample_profile.yaml contains a clearly labeled 'inferred' section with example entries

checklist.name: Learned profile section
checklist.description: sample_profile.yaml contains a clearly labeled 'learned' section with example entries

checklist.name: No instruction leakage
checklist.description: task.md (the scenario task) does NOT mention the setup subcommand name, the three layer names, or the four data directory files — the agent had to know these from the skill
